name: explosion-fire
comment: WP-1.8 flaming Explosion: the explode op with flaming (World.newExplosion(null, 0.5, 61.5, 0.5, 3, true), ExplosionRNG seeded mix(seed, -6)) at t=1 over a stone floor (y 57-60). doExplosionA places fire (setBlockWithNotify, BlockFire.onBlockAdded) on destroyed positions that are already air above an opaque block, 1 in 3 from ExplosionRNG; doExplosionB then clears every destroyed position again, those fires included (vanilla order: the fire is set before the blocks are removed). scheduled_ticks (full) pins where the fires were (their scheduled ticks stay), rng_state every tick, block_box at t=1 and the end. Needs BlockFire (fire task of WP-1.6) in the port.
